abstract.text: KurozoraKit is a simple to use framework for interacting with the Kurozora API.

inlineContent.text: lets users manage their anime, manga, games and music library and access many other services from your app. When users provide permission to access their Kurozora account, they can use your app to share anime, add it to their library, and discover any of the thousands of content in the Kurozora catalog. If your app detects that the user is not yet a Kurozora member, you can offer them to create an account within your app.
KurozoraKit is built with Swift, one of the
By utilizing the power of Swift Concurrency, KurozoraKit is more readable and less prone to errors like data races and deadlocks by design.
The kit is carefully designed to work as efficient and reliable as you would expect it to.
. The way KurozoraKit works together with the Kurozora API is truly otherworldly.
